rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a full blastocyst and acknowledges a less-expanded Day 5 embryo, but it overstates confidence in ICM/TE quality from this single image and describes features like a clearly cohesive TE and well-defined cavity that are not sharply discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian response, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall structure is logical, but the quantitative probability adjustment is somewhat speculative and the strong recommendation to defer transfer based mainly on smoking/alcohol likely overreaches relative to the otherwise favorable case.

Many points are guideline-concordant (SET, no routine PGT-A/ERA after one biochemical), but recommending freeze-all deferral, augmented luteal support, Doppler/EmbryoGlue emphasis, and immunologic testing/NK cells after recurrent biochemical losses is not strongly guideline-based.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, lifestyle counseling, and contingency plans, though some recommendations are more aggressive than standard practice.
